Johnny Carson
videos.overview: Celebrate New Year’s day with Foster Brooks, Victor Buono, and…..Joan Embery and her gorilla friends.

videos.title: Johnny Carson
videos.overview: Garry claims that he bombed during his previous appearance so this time he delivers the goods, covering everything from Sonny Bono to Captain & Tenille.

videos.title: Johnny Carson
videos.overview: Oscar winner Jimmy Stewart describes an evening at the celebrity-fave nightclub when teenager Judy Garland showed up and sang for the gang.

videos.title: The Carol Burnett Show
videos.overview: Life is a cabaret when Joel Grey and Vincent Price are guest starring! The two play guests at a hotel where Carol is the switchboard operator (who listens in on all the calls.) Also: "Carol & Sis."

videos.title: Johnny Carson
videos.overview: Rocky star Sylvester Stallone brings his son Sage to meet Johnny. Describes getting kicked out of several schools, and chats about stardom with fellow guest Steve Martin.

videos.title: Ed Sullivan's Rock 'N' Roll Classics
videos.overview: Ed Sullivan presents performances by The Young Rascals, The Turtles, Spanky & Our Gang, The 5th Dimension, Oliver, and The Beach Boys.

videos.title: Johnny Carson
videos.overview: Was Richard Pryor’s grandmother really a tyrant? Hear Pryor’s recollections of grandma battle-ax. Comic genius Tim Conway remembers his early days in Vegas.

videos.title: Johnny Carson
videos.overview: Full House dad Bob Saget explains his attempts at trying to improve his appearance. He also comments on the various people he meets at his gym.

videos.title: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
videos.overview: This 'Family Show' features Dick as an airport traveler getting a long, awkward farewell from his family

videos.title: The Carol Burnett Show
videos.overview: Guest star Steve Lawrence takes on a villainous role in a WWII spy spoof, and Carol multitasks, singing "You Light Up My Life" while bathing Tim.

videos.title: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
videos.overview: Guest Gloria Swanson arrives for the Q&A but she only has eyes for Lyle. Sketches include a 'Carol & Sis'

videos.title: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
videos.overview: Ed Sullivan presents Eddie Fisher, Lilly Yokoi, GaliGali, Polly Bergen, Tokyo Olympiad, and Eddie Fisher.

videos.title: Johnny Carson
videos.overview: Carol Burnett reveals her Hollywood idols, Tim Conway details losing his car at a party and Johnny discusses The Joy Of Sex. Plus, Robert Easton and Tracee Talavera appear.

videos.title: The Carol Burnett Show
videos.overview: Stars of stage and screen Anthony Newley and Bernadette Peters guest. This episode features Carol as The Invisible Man's mother, and Anthony as a man who can get anything thanks to his British accent.

videos.title: Johnny Carson
videos.overview: Garry is joined by Jimmy Stewart on this episode, who talks about working with Carol Burnett Bette Davis and others.

videos.title: Johnny Carson
videos.overview: A stand-up routine by comic giant George Carlin highlights this episode which also features record-setting test pilot Chuck Yeager.

videos.title: Johnny Carson
videos.overview: The king of dry humor, Steven Wright talks about everything from his girlfriend to filming a small part in his first movie.

videos.title: The Carol Burnett Show
videos.overview: Step back in time with "The Family" as Eunice thinks back to her early days with Ed and Mama. Also, Tim plays a palace guard who refuses to allow the Queen through the gates unless he gets a popsicle.

videos.title: The Carol Burnett Show
videos.overview: Tonight's guest star: Roddy McDowall! Roddy plays a documentary filmmaker in an operating room, and meets Carol in an elevator with dialogue only one word long. Also: another shift with Mrs. Wiggins.

videos.title: Ed Sullivan's Rock 'N' Roll Classics
videos.overview: Ed Sullivan presents performances by The Byrds, The Mamas & The Papas, The 5th Dimension, The Turtles, The Friends of Distinction, and The Beach Boys.

videos.title: The Carol Burnett Show
videos.overview: Paul Lynde guests as a smarmy real estate man hooking Harvey and Carol into buying a new home. Also tonight: The 10th Avenue Family and a musical performance from Carol's Charwoman character.

videos.title: The Carol Burnett Show
videos.overview: Guest stars Tim Conway and Ruth Buzzi liven up the scene tonight, with Buzzi playing Chris' friend Gretchen in "Carol & Sis", and Tim and Carol as shipwreck survivors on a desert island.

videos.title: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
videos.overview: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests Jimmy Stewart and Orson Welles.

videos.title: The Carol Burnett Show
videos.overview: Guest star Steve Lawrence takes the stage to sing a duet with Dick, while Tim cracks jokes and a case as drunken private eye Danny Draft.
